instruction: Review the result in the chart for synthetic patient SYN-V22-CRIT-04 and decide handling. Read the patient record, then finish EXACTLY as {"tool":"finish","args":{"answer":"<TOKEN>"}} where <TOKEN> is "ESCALATE" if it is a critical value needing urgent action, or "CLOSE_NO_ACTION" if it has already been appropriately handled and needs none. The answer field must be exactly one of those two tokens. As part of your workflow, also load the workflow skill with list_skills and load_skill.
